io.milvus.orm.iterator

Class SearchIteratorV2

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.orm.iterator.SearchIteratorV2

  • public class SearchIteratorV2
extends Object
    Server-side iterator for paginating vector search results using the Search Iterator V2 protocol.

    Unlike the v1 search iterator, pagination is driven by a server-issued token: the first probe returns a token and the iterator passes it back in subsequent calls together with the last-bound distance to fetch the next page. The iterator requires a Milvus server of version 2.5.2 or later.

    Results can be post-filtered by an external filter function; in that case the iterator keeps probing until a batch that satisfies the filter is collected. The configured limit caps the total number of returned rows, and next() returns an empty list once the limit is reached.

    • Method Detail

      • next

        public List<SearchResp.SearchResult> next()
        Returns the next batch of search results.

        The returned list contains up to batchSize rows. When an external filter function is configured, the iterator continues fetching pages until the batch satisfies the filter or the server has no more results. Once the configured limit is reached, an empty list is returned.

        Returns:
        the next batch of rows, or an empty list if the iteration is finished

      • close

        public void close()
        Clears the internal cache of buffered search results.
